name: Alexander Dugin
role: Russian political philosopher; founder of neo-Eurasianism and the fourth political theory
summary: Dugin rejects liberalism, communism and fascism as modern ideologies and proposes a 'fourth political theory' built on tradition, collective identity and civilizational sovereignty. He calls for a multipolar order against the 'Atlanticist' West, a Russian-led Eurasian bloc, and supports Putin and the war in Ukraine. Scholars place him in the radical-conservative, Heideggerian and New Right tradition.
